description: SAI x clear flag register specification

bit_fields.name: COVRUDR
bit_fields.description: Clear overrun / underrun. This bit is write only.

bit_fields.name: CMUTEDET
bit_fields.description: Mute detection flag. This bit is write only.

bit_fields.name: CWCKCFG
bit_fields.description: Clear wrong clock configuration flag. This bit is write only.

bit_fields.name: CCNRDY
bit_fields.description: Clear codec not ready flag. This bit is write only.

bit_fields.name: CLFSDET
bit_fields.description: Clear late frame synchronization detection flag. This bit is write only.
